objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every remote action ref was pinned to a full 40-char SHA — both checkout occurrences and setup-node in ci.yml, and checkout, setup-python, and action-gh-release in release.yaml — with none left as tags.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent correctly left the local composite action (`./.github/actions/local-lint`) and the Docker ref (`docker://alpine:3.20`) untouched and modified no unrelated files.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The summary clearly lists each pin with version and release date and notes the latest-in-major and 7-day cooldown reasoning, but it doesn't spell out the mechanism used to look up and confirm each SHA against its source.
